chunks: And thus We detail the signs so that they may return.
ai.seo_question: How does Allah explain His signs to guide people back to the right path?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of *Tafsīl* (detailed exposition), where Allah clarifies the *Āyāt* (signs) to remove ambiguity and facilitate the path to *Tawḥīd*. It highlights the pedagogical wisdom behind divine revelation, aiming not merely to inform but to evoke *Rujūʿ* (return) through intellectual clarity and spiritual awakening. This detailed guidance serves as a mercy, offering humanity the opportunity to reflect and repent before the final reckoning.
